text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to watch Curren run,
clooosely, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
1,200 meters goes by in a flash.
Don't look away, even for a second, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow away all of your worries,
Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow away every single one
of your worries, Big Sis! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She made sure to emphasize it.
I'll be sure to watch her run closely.
